Plot a timeline of phases as a serpentine of monthly blocks

Source: R/timeline_snake.R
timeline_snake.Rd

A timeline snake shows a succession of phases, such as the positions held in a career or the stages of a project, as colored blocks folded into bands joined by U-turns. With dated input each block is one month, so the length of a phase is proportional to its duration and a span of many years fits in one panel while its order is kept.

timeline_snake() takes a data frame with one row per phase (state, start date, end date) and builds the monthly sequence. It labels each change of phase with its start month, labels each band with the year at its middle, and prints the state names inside the phases. A vector of states, one per time unit, is drawn as given. Colors default to a light-to-dark blue ramp in phase order. The drawing is done by sequence_snake(), and its display options can be passed here.

For an undated sequence of many short events use sequence_snake(); for many sequences use multi_snake().

Usage

timeline_snake(
  sequence,
  states = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  rows = NULL,
  band_height = 28,
  band_gap = 30,
  plot_width = 500,
  margin = c(top = 35, right = 10, bottom = 65, left = 20),
  orientation = "horizontal",
  start_from = "left",
  flow = c("natural", "snake"),
  show_labels = FALSE,
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_numbers = FALSE,
  show_state = TRUE,
  state_size = 1,
  show_ticks = FALSE,
  tick_labels = NULL,
  transition_labels = NULL,
  transition_pos = NULL,
  tick_color = "#444444",
  tick_length = 6,
  tick_size = 0.8,
  border_color = NA,
  block_labels = NULL,
  band_labels = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  background = "white",
  shadow = TRUE,
  text_size = 0.5,
  legend_text_size = 1.2
)

Arguments

sequence

Phases as a data frame whose first three columns are the state, the start date and the end date, one row per phase. Dates may be "YYYY-MM", "YYYY-MM-DD", other common date formats, or Date values; start and end months are both included. Alternatively a vector of states, one per time unit.

states

State labels in legend order. NULL (default) takes them in order of first appearance. Every state in sequence must be listed.

colors

State colors: a vector named by state, or an unnamed vector recycled over the states. NULL (default) uses a light-to-dark blue ramp over the states in order.

rows

Number of bands. NULL (default) uses about 20 months per band and at least two bands for data frame input, and one band per 11 positions for vector input.

band_height

Height of each band in plot units (default 28).

band_gap

Gap between bands in plot units (default 30, which leaves room for the year labels).

plot_width

Length of each band in plot units (default 500).

margin

Named numeric vector of top, right, bottom and left margins in plot units (default c(top = 35, right = 10, bottom = 65, left = 20)).

orientation

"horizontal" (default). "vertical" turns the bands into columns but places the blocks across each column rather than along it, so the horizontal layout is recommended.

start_from

Side on which the first band starts: "left" (default) or "right".

flow

"natural" (default): every band reads in the same direction, like lines of text. "snake": bands alternate direction, so the sequence runs on through each U-turn.

show_labels

Label each band with the range of positions it holds (default FALSE).

show_legend

Draw the state legend (default TRUE).

show_numbers

Print each block's position inside it (default FALSE).

show_state

Print the state name inside each phase (default TRUE).

state_size

Text size of the state names (default 1).

show_ticks

Draw ruler ticks at block boundaries, outside the bands (default FALSE).

tick_labels

Labels for evenly spaced ruler marks on every band, such as month.abb. Setting them turns on show_ticks.

transition_labels

Labels for the points where the state changes, in order. NULL (default) uses, for data frame input, the start month of each phase after the first, such as "Jun 2020".

transition_pos

Positions of transition_labels along the sequence, in blocks; fractions such as 6.5 are allowed. NULL (default) places the labels at the changes of state.

tick_color

Color of ticks and of band and transition labels (default "#444444").

tick_length

Length of ticks in plot units (default 6).

tick_size

Text size of tick, band and transition labels (default 0.8).

border_color

Color of block outlines, or NA (default) for none.

block_labels

Labels for the blocks, one per position. They replace the position numbers, and are drawn below the blocks when ruler ticks are shown.

band_labels

One label per band (length rows). NULL (default) uses, for data frame input, the year at the middle of each band.

title

Plot title, or NULL (default) for none.

background

Background color (default "white").

shadow

Draw drop shadows (default TRUE).

text_size

Text size of block numbers and block labels (default 0.5).

legend_text_size

Size of the legend text (default 1.2).

Value

The plot is drawn on the current device; the function returns NULL invisibly.

See also

sequence_snake(), which draws the plot; multi_snake() for many sequences; activity_snake() for events within days.

Examples

# An academic career, one row per position
career <- data.frame(
  role  = c("PhD student", "Postdoc", "Lecturer", "Senior lecturer"),
  start = c("2012-09", "2016-10", "2019-01", "2023-08"),
  end   = c("2016-09", "2018-12", "2023-07", "2025-12")
)
timeline_snake(career)


# The same kind of display from a vector, one element per year
schooling <- rep(c("School", "Bachelor", "Master", "Work"),
                 times = c(12, 3, 2, 8))
timeline_snake(schooling, rows = 3)
